title: Combobox
description: CustomCombobox: type to filter a long or grouped list (diacritic-aware, IME-safe), then pick one value or keep a new one.
when: Long or grouped lists the user searches (materials, customers, repositories, SKUs).

instead.need: A short fixed list without search
Pick multiple values with removable chips

a11y: ARIA combobox: arrows move through matching enabled options (skipping group headings), Enter picks, Escape closes; works inside Field.
Option groups use role="group" + aria-labelledby so headings are announced and not selectable; a heading disappears when none of its options match.

examples.title: Grouped options
examples.description: Pass group on consecutive options; headings stay only while one of their options matches.
